The main takeaway from our work is that
meal-time glucose levels are an important determinant of cardiovascular disease in diabetes.
the post-prandial glucose concentration is a better predictor than the basal glucose level for the development of microvascular and macro vascular disease.

meal-time glucose levels have a major impact on the development and progression of vascular complications, and therefore, the management of meal-time glucose should be an integral component of any treatment plan.
